meta.title: Bella Nails – Nail Salon in Ørestad, Copenhagen | Shellac, Gel & BIAB
meta.description: Bella Nails is an intimate nail salon in Ørestad by Bella Kvarter, Copenhagen. Gel extensions, classic manicure, Shellac and BIAB. Book online.

serviceMenu.metaDescription: The full menu of treatments at Bella Nails in Ørestad — gel extensions, manicure, Shellac and BIAB, with prices and durations.
serviceMenu.intro: A considered menu of nail treatments — classic manicure, gel extensions, Shellac and BIAB — performed one client at a time in our private nail studio in Ørestad, Copenhagen. Every session is built around the health of your natural nails.
serviceMenu.imageAlt: {category} at Bella Nails — nail salon in Ørestad, Copenhagen
serviceMenu.pricingNoteBody: Our pricing reflects the full cost of premium-grade materials, private studio time, and the years of expertise behind each treatment. We do not operate discount structures or promotional pricing.
serviceMenu.policyNote: All prices include materials. Sessions are private and by appointment only, and a 24-hour cancellation policy applies.

booking.metaTitle: Book Online – Nail Salon in Ørestad, Copenhagen
booking.metaDescription: Book your nail appointment online: classic manicure, gel extensions, Shellac and BIAB at Bella Nails — a private nail salon in Ørestad, Copenhagen.
booking.intro: Begin composing your appointment. Choose from classic manicure, gel extensions, Shellac and BIAB below — in the next steps you'll tailor your treatment with add-ons and pick a time that suits you. Every session is private, reserved for you alone.
booking.addonsIntro: Enhance your appointment with one or more add-ons — everything is performed within the same private session. Your total price and duration update as you choose, and you'll pick a date and time in the next step.
booking.noAddons: This treatment has no add-ons — continue straight to choosing your time.
booking.detailsIntro: Almost there — tell us who the session is for. We use your details only to confirm your appointment and to reach you about it, nothing else.

fields.notesPlaceholder: Anything we should know before your session

booking.privacyNote: Your details are held privately and never shared. We'll only contact you in relation to your appointment.
booking.signInPrompt: Already a client? <link>Sign in</link> and we'll fill these in for you.
booking.confirmIntro: The final step — pick the date and time that suits you. Your treatment, add-ons and details travel with your appointment, and your confirmation arrives by email.
booking.consent: By reserving a session you agree to our <terms>terms of service</terms>, including the 24-hour cancellation policy.
booking.timeNote: You'll choose the date and time in the next step.
booking.paymentNote: Payment is collected at the studio. 24-hour cancellation policy applies.

bookings.metaDescription: See and manage your appointments at Bella Nails — reschedule, cancel or book your next session.
bookings.intro: Your appointments, your photos, and requests from Bella Nails — all in one place.
bookings.cancelDialogBody: Your time will be released and a cancellation confirmation will arrive by email. You can always book a new session.
bookings.cancelFailed: We couldn't cancel it — try again or contact the studio.
bookings.rescheduleMetaDescription: Pick a new time for your appointment at Bella Nails — your treatment and details move with your appointment.
bookings.rescheduleIntro: Pick the time that suits you better — your treatment and details move with your appointment, and a new confirmation arrives by email.
bookings.within24h: Within 24 hours of your session — call or write the studio to make changes.
bookings.emptyBody: When you book a session, it will appear here — with everything you need to manage it.
bookings.noUpcomingBody: Your next visit is a few clicks away — the menu is waiting.
bookings.noticePolicy: That appointment can no longer be changed online — call or write the studio and we'll sort it out.
bookings.loadError: We couldn't load your appointments right now — please try again in a moment.
bookings.galleryEmptyBody: Photos from your appointments will appear here.
bookings.requestsEmptyBody: Requests from Bella Nails will appear here.
bookings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes it from Bella Nails — including any copy shared to the website or social. This can’t be undone.
bookings.withdrawDataTitle: Ask us to stop using this?
bookings.withdrawDataBody: We'll stop using it. Our website updates right away; anything on social we take down by hand, usually within a few days. You can allow it again whenever you like.
bookings.shareStatePrivate: This photo is private — only you and Bella Nails can see it.
bookings.shareStateWebsite: You've shared this photo with Bella Nails to use on their website. Changed your mind? <link>Remove your permission</link>.
bookings.shareStateSocial: You've shared this photo with Bella Nails to use in their social media campaigns. Changed your mind? <link>Remove your permission</link>.
bookings.shareStateBoth: You've shared this photo with Bella Nails to use on their website and in their social media campaigns. Changed your mind? <link>Remove a permission</link>.
bookings.withdrawManageTitle: We'd love to keep sharing it
bookings.withdrawManageBody: We really love this photo of your set and hope you feel the same — but it's completely your call. It always stays in your own gallery, and you're welcome to share it with us again anytime.
bookings.withdrawSiteNote: Comes off our website right away.
bookings.withdrawSomeNote: We take it down from our social posts by hand, usually within a few days.
bookings.withdrawDoneNote: That's done — this photo is private again. You're welcome to share it with us again anytime.

gallery.comingSoon: The complete portfolio — sets, before & afters, and signature looks — is on its way. In the meantime, the chair is ready.

confirmation.metaTitle: Appointment Confirmed – Bella Nails, Ørestad, Copenhagen
confirmation.metaDescription: Your appointment at Bella Nails is confirmed. Review your session details and manage your appointments.
confirmation.intro: It's official — your time at the studio is set aside for you alone. A confirmation with all the details is on its way to your email.
confirmation.arrivalNote: The studio is private and by appointment only — arrive at your booked time and everything will be ready for you.
confirmation.recapFallback: Your appointment is confirmed — the full details are in your confirmation email.
confirmation.recapCancelled: This appointment has since been cancelled. If you rescheduled, the confirmation email for your new time has the up-to-date details.
confirmation.accountTitle: Create an account to manage your appointments
confirmation.accountBody: Verify your email with a one-time code — no password needed — and reschedule, cancel or rebook in one place.
confirmation.signedInBody: Your appointment is linked to your account — reschedule, cancel or rebook whenever you need.

errors.title: This didn't go to plan
errors.body: An unexpected error interrupted this page. It's usually only temporary — please try again, and if it keeps happening, the studio is only a message away.

notFound.intro: The page you're looking for isn't here — it may have moved, or the link led somewhere that no longer exists. Let us guide you back to the studio.

formula.headingAccent: even on the most difficult nails.
formula.body: Difficult nails are exactly why I do this. I've lived with thin, brittle nails myself — so I know how discouraging they are, and how good it feels when they finally hold. Every set I do is built on Didier Lab gel: HEMA-free, vegan, reinforced with invisible fiberglass and enriched with Vitamin E and calcium. Lasting strength that leaves your own nails better than I found them.

one.title: Private Sessions, Fully Yours
one.body: By appointment only, with the studio reserved for one client at a time.

two.title: Premium Formulas, Carefully Chosen
two.body: European gel systems selected for lasting wear, finish, and nail health.

three.title: Difficult Nails, Done Properly
three.body: Built with lasting quality even on difficult nails, backed by our studio guarantee.

one.quote: The most considered nail experience I have ever had. The silence alone is worth the price.

two.quote: Nothing is rushed here. Every detail is attended to with a calm I have not found elsewhere in the city.
two.name: Sara B.

three.name: Mathilde V.
